lead: A side goal's worktree has none of the git-ignored fixtures the main checkout holds, so a floor check reading one fails there with `E0605`.
body: `tests/db/ca.crt` is a copy of a Docker volume's certificate that `nvs.toml` names for the fixtures and that `.gitignore` keeps out of git, so `nvs queue migrate` in `.agent-tmp/worktrees/side/<slug>` reports `cannot read ... tests/db/ca.crt` while the same check is green on `main`. Copy it from the main checkout (`cp D:/mwl/tests/db/ca.crt tests/db/ca.crt`) before reading the failure as work the goal owes.
